Convert between positions, supervoxels and root IDs

octo_xyz2id.Rd

octo_xyz2id() finds the neuron (root ID) or supervoxel at positions, octo_rootid() the root ID of supervoxels, and octo_leaves() the supervoxels (or level-2 chunks) that make up a neuron. With timestamp, root IDs are looked up as they were at that time instead of now (see also octo_ids_at()).

Usage

octo_xyz2id(
  xyz,
  voxels = TRUE,
  root = TRUE,
  timestamp = NULL,
  batch_size = 10000L,
  checkpoint = NULL,
  res = NULL
)

octo_rootid(svids, timestamp = NULL)

octo_leaves(id, level = 1)

Arguments

xyz

positions: n x 3 matrix / data.frame, or text like "1234, 5678, 910" (see parse_position())

voxels

TRUE if positions are Spelunker voxel coordinates, FALSE if they are nm

root

return root IDs (TRUE) or supervoxel IDs (FALSE)

timestamp

look up root IDs at this time instead of now: POSIXct, Date or text such as "2026-11-01 14:00" (read as UTC unless it has an offset, e.g. "2026-11-01T15:00:00+01:00")

batch_size

points looked up per batch. Each segmentation chunk is downloaded once per batch for all points in it, so larger batches are faster for clustered points (e.g. synapses) but use more memory.

checkpoint

optional .rds file to save results after every batch. Rerunning with the same file skips points already looked up, so a long run can be resumed after an interruption.

res

voxel size (nm) of the positions; overrides voxels

svids

supervoxel IDs (character)

id

one root ID (character)

level

1 for supervoxels, 2 for level-2 chunks (far fewer, faster)

Value

character vector of IDs ("0" where a position hits no segment)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
octo_xyz2id("11434, 13413, 2501")
octo_xyz2id(cbind(91472, 107304, 20008), voxels = FALSE)
octo_xyz2id("11434, 13413, 2501", timestamp = "2026-10-01")   # as it was then

# many points, resumable
syn <- readRDS("synapses_v8_positions.rds")
pre <- syn[, c("pre_pt_position_x", "pre_pt_position_y", "pre_pt_position_z")]
syn$pre_root <- octo_xyz2id(pre, voxels = FALSE, checkpoint = "pre_ids.rds")
} # }
